item.title: West Elk Word: T.J. Taylor with the IceLab - 3/9/26 - KBUT Online
item.description: T.J. Taylor is the Director of the IceLab (in this case, ICE stands for Innovation, Creativity, and Entrepreneurship). The IceLab supports local businesses and would-be entrepreneurs, facilitates connections to help them start, build, and grow their business, offers state-of-the-art co-working, warehouse, and shipping space, and facilitates connections in the Gunnison Valley and beyond.

item.title: West Elk Word: Moss Wagner, author of "Adventures on the Hippie Trail (and sometimes off) 1972-75 - 3/16/26 - KBUT Online
item.description: Buses, trains, cheap, often sketchy lodging, (or, in somecases camping) perilous border crossings, and encounters with all sorts of nefarious and colorful characters - these are just a few of the experiences along, and sometimes off, the hippie trail. It's a fun read, written by one of our own.
